alternative_explanations: A positive effect may be ordinary BPE, Lempel-Ziv, Sequitur, or suffix indexing rather than a distinct learned computational principle.
confounds: Weak supervision exposes output label order and the synthetic generator guarantees motif identifiability; success does not establish raw language understanding.
falsification_criteria: Kill the learned motif route if it is inexact, performs false reuse, fails held-out composition, or is matched or dominated by exact suffix/grammar controls at the same capability once fit, raw scan, search, state, update, and query work are counted.

outcome_policy.negative: If learned segmentation is inexact or unsafe while exact classical controls succeed, strengthen HYP-0012 modestly and discard this implementation family.
outcome_policy.null: If learned and classical methods have matched capability and classical controls match or dominate cost, retain HYP-0012 and make this motif route dormant without tuning.
outcome_policy.positive: Treat an exact non-dominated learned result as counterevidence to HYP-0012 in this raw-byte family and allocate exactly one adversarial multi-seed replication.

predicted_outcome: Exact suffix search and the learned contrastive motif composer should recover identifiable motifs and transfer to held-out compositions with exact precision, while fixed trigrams may work only on exposed cores, LZ/Sequitur may absorb distractors, and dense recurrence may fail exact compositional extrapolation. The learned route is expected to pay K-growing discovery cost and gain no capability over the strongest exact classical control, supporting HYP-0012 rather than refuting it.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. A learned route earns one three-seed adversarial screen only if it has exact held-out and near-equivalent accuracy, reuse precision 1, no false reuse, and is non-dominated with a materially better K signature than every implementable classical control under full accounting.
research_question: Can a learned variable-length motif segmenter infer reusable operations from weakly supervised unsegmented noisy byte streams and compose held-out motif sequences with exact rejection and a non-dominated full-system cost relative to fixed n-grams, Lempel-Ziv, Sequitur, exact suffix search, and dense recurrence?
title: Raw-byte motif induction under held-out composition
